text_overrides.value:
We started Real Skin Care because the labels lied. "Natural" lotions still used petroleum jelly. "Gentle" creams still relied on silicones. "Sensitive" formulas still snuck in synthetic fragrance under names most buyers don't recognize.

We built every product in our line from the opposite direction. We asked what sensitive skin actually tolerates, then used the shortest ingredient list that does the job. Nothing else.
